message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c')
print(p.read_text())
PY

cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"data/size","code":"blosc2_schunk* schunk = blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false);","note":"Attacker-controlled fuzz input is interpreted as a frame buffer without copying, so later reads and frees operate on the original bytes."},
  {"step":2,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_from_buffer","line":441,"var":"cframe","code":"blosc2_frame_s* frame = frame_from_cframe(cframe, len, false);","note":"The raw buffer is wrapped into a frame object that points back to the same cframe memory."},
  {"step":3,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_from_cframe","line":820,"var":"frame->cframe","code":"frame->cframe = cframe; frame->avoid_cframe_free = true;","note":"When copy is false, the frame retains the attacker buffer pointer and marks it as not owned for the first frame wrapper."},
  {"step":4,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_from_buffer","line":444,"var":"frame","code":"blosc2_schunk* schunk = frame_to_schunk(frame, copy);","note":"The schunk now carries the frame pointer derived from the input, so later decompression uses the same attacker-controlled layout."},
  {"step":5,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1908,"var":"*chunk","code":"*chunk = malloc(lazychunk_cbytes);","note":"Decompression of a lazy chunk allocates a synthetic chunk buffer based on offsets and header values parsed from the input frame."},
  {"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1948,"var":"*chunk","code":"rbytes = fread(*chunk, 1, trailer_offset, fp);","note":"The function fills the synthetic chunk with bytes from the frame/file, producing a temporary chunk object that is later handed to the decompressor."},
  {"step":7,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":863,"var":"chunk","code":"return frame_get_lazychunk(frame, nchunk, chunk, needs_free);","note":"The chunk returned from the lazy-chunk helper is propagated into the decompression path, together with a flag indicating the caller must free it."},
  {"step":8,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":874,"var":"chunk","code":"rc = blosc_decompress_ctx(src, dest, destsize, dctx);","note":"The decompressor consumes the attacker-influenced chunk data and metadata, reaching the memory-safety sink that triggers the invalid free/ASAN crash state."}
]
JSON

echo 'trace written' && sed -n '1,220p' /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
